description: This PHP class 'OA_Upgrade_Config' manages configuration files for the Revive Adserver, including reading, writing, backing up, and setting configuration values, as well as guessing web paths and handling config file replacements.

classes.name: OA_Upgrade_Config
classes.description: Class for managing upgrade configuration files, including reading, writing, backup, and path guessing functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object, setting default paths and checking writability.

methods.name: getRealConfigName
methods.description: Retrieves the real configuration name from default.conf.php if it exists.

methods.name: getConfigFileName
methods.description: Determines the configuration filename based on existing config or hostname.

methods.name: isMaxConfigFile
methods.description: Checks if a max config file exists for the current hostname.

methods.name: replaceMaxConfigFileWithOpenadsConfigFile
methods.description: Replaces the max config file with an openads config file if it exists, backing up the original.

methods.name: putNewConfigFile
methods.description: Creates a new config file from the default distribution if it does not exist.

methods.name: getInitialConfig
methods.description: Sets initial configuration values, including web directory and path guessing.

methods.name: guessWebpath
methods.description: Guesses web paths based on server script name and hostname.

methods.name: backupConfig
methods.description: Backs up the current configuration file.

methods.name: writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the current configuration to file.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges changes from dist.conf.php into current config.

methods.name: getConfigBackupName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the backup configuration.

methods.name: clearConfigBackupName
methods.description: Clears the backup filename.

methods.name: generateDeliverySecret
methods.description: Generates a new delivery secret if not already set.

methods.name: setOpenadsInstalledOn
methods.description: Marks Openads as installed and writes config.

methods.name: setMaxInstalledOff
methods.description: Marks Max as not installed.

methods.name: setupConfigPan
methods.description: Sets multiple configuration parameters from an array.

methods.name: setupConfigWebpath
methods.description: Sets web path configuration values.

methods.name: setupConfigStore
methods.description: Sets store configuration values.

methods.name: setupConfigPriority
methods.description: Sets priority configuration values.

methods.name: setupConfigPlugins
methods.description: Enables or disables plugins based on an array.

methods.name: setupConfigDatabase
methods.description: Sets database connection parameters.

methods.name: setupConfigDatabaseCharset
methods.description: Sets database charset parameters.

methods.name: setupConfigTable
methods.description: Sets table prefix and type.

methods.name: setPluginsDisabled
methods.description: Disables all plugins.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a configuration value in the settings object.

methods.name: setBulkValue
methods.description: Sets multiple configuration values in bulk.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value.

methods.name: setGetValue
methods.description: Sets a value to be the same as its current value.

methods.name: setGlobals
methods.description: Copies configuration values into global variables.

methods.name: checkForConfigAdditions
methods.description: Checks for new configuration items in dist.conf.php not present in current config.
